content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessOscars 2026 recap‘One Battle After Another’ wins best picture after big nightUpdated March 15, 2026 at 10:55 p.m. EDT|Published March 15, 2026 at 4:53 p.m. EDTPaul Thomas Anderson and Sara Murphy accept the award for best picture for "One Battle After Another" alongside cast and crew. (Patrick T. Fallon/AFP/Getty Images)1 minIt was a showdown between “Sinners” and “One Battle After Another” at the 2026 Oscars Sunday night, but in the end it was Paul Thomas Anderson’s thriller about left-wing ex-revolutionaries that won best picture. The hotly contested best actor race saw Michael B.
